samples.reference_raw: Mujhe Saturday ke liye Delhi se Mumbai train chahiye
Bengaluru se Chennai ki Rajdhani Express ka ticket price kitna hai
Doctor appointment book karni hai for acute chest pain
Kal morning 10 AM ka slot available hai kya hospital mein
Actually Sunday ko travel karna hai please date change kar do
Platform number three par train kab arrive hogi kindly inform
Cardiologist se consult karna urgently zaroori hai
PNR status check karna hai confirm seat mila ya waiting list
Flight delay hone ki wajah se train catch karna mushkil lag raha hai
General physician se consultation fee kitni charge hoti hai
Howrah se Patna junction superfast express ka departure time bataiye
Tatkal quota mein ticket booking start ho chuki hai kya
Train number 12301 ka live running status show kijiye
First AC coach mein confirmed berth available hai ya nahi
Senior citizen concession railway rules mein allow hota hai
Vande Bharat express ki average speed aur stoppages kya hain
Dermatologist ke paas skin allergy checkup ke liye jana hai
Blood pressure monitor report doctor ko dikhani hai urgent
Saturday evening six thirty PM ka slot confirm kar dijiye
Orthopedic surgeon se knee replacement consult karna hai
Pediatrician available hain kya clinic par children checkup ke liye
Meeting schedule change ho gaya hai after lunch call karein
Weather forecast dekh kar lagta hai heavy rain expect kar sakte hain
Online payment failed ho gaya but amount bank account se deduct ho gaya
Customer support executive se connect karwayiye please immediately
